Guidance & outlook: 7800 05/08/2026 30th Annual Report 2025-2026 Page 32 MANAGEMENT DISCUSSION AND ANALYSIS REPORT ECONOMIC OUTLOOK GLOBAL ECONOMY The global economy exhibited resilience during FY 2025 -26 despite persistent geopolitical tensions, elevated trade uncertainties, and volatile commodity prices.

The Reserve Bank of India and the International Monetary Fund have projected India's GDP growth at around 6.5% for FY 202 5-26, reaffirming the country's position as a preferred investment destination.

The Company's continued focus on quality, customer satisfaction, product innovation and brand development is expected to support sustainable growth while creating long -term value for all stakeholders 30th Annual Report 2025-2026 Page 37 OPPORTUNITIES AND THREATS Opportunities  The Indian government has several portals for the welfare of laborers.
Growth & demand: Our long standing tradition of excellence coupled with diligent service and unwavering commitment towards our customers has earned us their trust in such a way that we command a market share of 45%-50% in the markets where we have a presence.
GROWTH STRATEGY Your Company has taken measures for the growth and expansion of the business.

According to the International Monetary Fund (IMF), global economic growth is estimated at appr oximately 3.0% for financial year 2025 -2026, supported by easing inflation, gradual monetary policy normalization, and improving consumer demand across major economies.
Margins & costs: The industry continued to witness intense competition, with manufacturers operating under pressure from increasing input costs, volatile cotton prices, rising labour expenses, and higher log istics costs.

Additionally, rise in the overall raw material consumption cost also impacted the industry a nd the Company could not increase the required selling price of the products as compared to increase in the cost of raw materials.
(i) Cost of raw materials and packing materials includes cost of purchase and other costs incurred in bringing the inventories to their present location and condition.
Capex & expansion: This has resulted into the expansion of our product horizon, opening various doors of opportunities for the Company and thereby exposing our reach to wider market coverage.

Balance sheet & cash: DIVIDEND Keeping in view the current economic uncertainties, your directors consider it prudent to plough back the profits and not to recommend any dividend for the financial year 2025-2026.
(C) Cash Flow: Cash Flow Statement has been prepared on the basis of ‘Indirect Method' as prescribed under AS-3.
The company has provided for a Provision for doubtful debt of Rs.20,35,512.
Risks & challenges: Rising global uncertainties, changing trade dynamics, and persistent pricing pressures created a challenging business environment.

STATE OF COMPANY AFFAIRS Your Directors report that due to high volatility in market, steep increase in raw material prices and several other challenges, your Company faced some decline in sales and revenue as well as in net profits during the year under review.
RISK MANAGEMENT The Company has business Risk Management framework to identify and evaluate business risks and opportunities.
